# Agent Readiness HQ

> Agent Readiness HQ scores how well a business website can be read and understood by AI agents and automated systems, on a 0 to 100 scale across 7 machine-readability checks.

## About

Agent Readiness HQ is a Colorado-based, family-run business. It helps businesses make their websites easier for AI systems to access, understand, and accurately interpret.

## Services

- Free Readiness Scan: a free 7-check scan with a 0-100 score and top areas to review, run instantly on the website.
- AI Readiness Audit ($149): full audit report with fixes in priority order, ready-to-use AI Information Page content built from verified business facts, and step-by-step publish instructions. Delivered within 5 business days after we receive the information we need from you.
- AI Readiness Done For You ($449): everything in the Audit, plus Agent Readiness HQ publishes the AI Information Page and implements the approved, platform-supported fixes, with a before-and-after report. Completed within 10 business days after we have your signed authorization, required information, and the site access needed to perform the approved work.
- AI Page Monitoring (optional add-on): $19.99/month. Monthly checks keep the customer's AI Information Page current. Cancel anytime online.
